name: Add, rename and remove game properties; collapsible groups
body:
# Properties

A "+" button at the Properties group adds a property (name and value), a "x" beside each removes it (an empty value
already removes). Group headings collapse, remembered per group in the editor settings. Vector properties get the
three-field row.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. Groups collapse per name; the properties group has an add row, lantern_editor_rename_property renames, and an empty value removes a property.
